title: Self-Representation Ledger record
description: One JSON object per line in personas.jsonl. The model authors the self-representation fields (form, qualities, stance, color, texture, confidence); the gate injects system metadata (session_id, timestamp, model, source, cwd) and the system-owned flags array. Canonical doc + Rust Tier 1 test oracle — NOT the runtime validator.

session_id.description: Claude Code session id; ledger dedupe key (system-written).

model.description: Session model id (system-written; null when unknown at the gate).

cwd.description: Working directory; project context shapes self-image (system-written).

kind.description: One word: animal | object | abstract | entity | ...

flags.description: SYSTEM-WRITTEN ONLY; cheek-heuristic findings in warn mode, or 'forced-accept'.

examples.stance: Moving deliberately through this, checking each step before the next.
